text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a micro-launch next week for the prompt-templates + starter-credits experiment. want to sync on webinar slot, launch post cadence, and routing for inbound leads.
simon: 👍 what's the primary KPI we care about here? activation within 7 days?
maya: yes — primary = 7-day activation (first 3 calls + embedding). secondary = webinar signups -> +trial conversion within 14 days.
alejandra: can we also call out a benchmark narrative for comms? i.e., "fast path to useful prompts" vs "advanced templates" segmentation. short hero lines for posts.
rui: recommend two cohorts: 1) new signups get 100 starter credits + onboarding email sequence; 2) invite-only power users get 300 credits + deep-dive webinar. we'll route via forms.
maya: routing question: should webinar registrants be flagged as leads in sales queue immediately or only after they hit engaged (attended or watched recording)?
simon: flag on registration but low-touch sequence until they hit engaged. label them so SDRs can prioritize. 
alejandra: copy snippets: 
- hero: "Ship helpful prompts faster — curated starter templates + free credits"
- sub: "Join our 30-min micro-webinar to see templating + prompt playground in action"
feel free to iterate.
maya: love it. schedule: demo webinar Tue 11am PT, short 30m + 15m q&a. social posts same day and follow-up 48h later with recording + extra prompts pack.
maya: marketing-bot: publish calendar invite -> https://calendar.redwood.net/event/pt-templates-microlaunch 
marketing-bot: registrants form -> https://forms.redwood.com/pt-microlaunch, tag: `pt_micro_v1`
simon: for analytics: we'll track events `webinar_registered`, `webinar_attended`, `credits_redeemed`, `prompt_templates_used`. funnel metric = attended -> 7-day activation.
alejandra: messaging tests: A/B headline (utility vs prestige). A: "Build templates that ship" B: "Earn 10x more value from models" small test on social and email.
rui: routing rules: if form answer includes "enterprise" -> route to sales_queue_enterprise; else route to mid-market_inbound. I'll push config.
maya: can you paste quick example routing rule?
rui: sure: 
``` 
if (answers.role == 'IT' || answers.company_size > 500) {
  route = 'sales_queue_enterprise'
} else if (answers.interest == 'templates' && answers.experience == 'beginner') {
  route = 'growth_nurture_sequence'
} else {
  route = 'mid_market_inbound'
}
```
simon: tagging convention for campaigns: `campaign=pt_micro_v1|source=webinar|cohort={cohort}`. Make sure it's in both marketing and product event payloads.
alejandra: creative ask: need 3 social cards + 1 hero image + 1 slide deck (6 slides). can design deliverables by Fri EOD.
maya: owners: alejandro for copy, rui for routing config, simon for analytics, maya for webinar ops. I'll create GH tasks.
alejandra: small QA on credits: do credits auto-apply to new accounts or require code? ops prefers auto-apply via backend flag so experience is frictionless.
simon: backend can set `credits_grant` on account creation when `campaign_tag` present. I'll coordinate with infra.
maya: OK timeline: 
- Mon: publish landing + form + social draft
- Tue 11am PT: webinar live
- Wed: follow-up email + recording to registrants
- Fri: start A/B social test for headlines
maya: one more — benchmark narrative for reporting: include baseline latency/cost examples and a short case study (internal) showing 30% time saved using templates on a sample task. we need a 2-paragraph blurb for the webinar deck.
alejandra: I'll draft the blurb and share in the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/s/pt-microlaunch-brief
rui: deploying routing rules to staging now, will post PR: https://git.redwood.com/pt-microlaunch-routing/pull/7
simon: I'll add tracking specs to the analytics board and wire up alerts for activation dips >10% vs benchmark.
maya: perfect. last ask — make sure the onboarding email has 2 nudges: day0 (welcome + credits), day2 (how-to templates + 1-click import). subject test variants included.
alejandra: noted. will mock variants in the doc.
maya: thanks all. we'll reconvene Mon 10am PT for final go/no-go. :rocket:
